depictions.name: Dorogawa Onsen
depictions.text: The Dorogawa Onsen was a spring located in southern Yamato, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the village near the onsen while going through the province.
